newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch cargo handler Avia Presto makes 96 loss.
newsitem.headline: Dutch cargo handler Avia Presto makes 96 loss.

text.p: Dutch handling company, Avia Presto made a loss for 1996, a spokesman for its parent company HIM Furness, of Rotterdam, said on Friday.
But he declined to give loss figure involved, although he said 1996 turnover had increased by 10 percent.
He added: "There have been difficult market circumstances and the losses have been made through inefficiencies between the different Avia Presto sites."
He referred to the fact that Avia Presto is based at several sites at Amsterdam Schiphol airport and transportation between these meant the company operated inefficiently.
However, this year the handling company is concentrating its activities on a single new warehouse and office complex at the Dutch airport.
